app.name: RiftWii
app.long_description:
RiftWii loads Riivolution-format mod packs (XML in sd:/riivolution) into Wii games from the disc, a USB drive or the SD card, and can keep modded saves on the SD card, apart from your Wii saves.
Games that have mods show as tiles with their covers; 1 switches to all games. Pick a game, open Mods, turn its packs on and pick their settings, and press Start. Games can also have cheats, picture settings and an online server (Wiimmfi, WiiLink WFC, AltWFC).
Dolphin's .rvz images play too, and the GameCube controller adapter for Wii U works in games that support the GameCube controller.
USB and SD games need a d2x cIOS (slots 248 to 252). The SD card must be FAT32; a USB drive may be FAT32 or NTFS.
Free software under the GPL, version 3 or later. It contains no Riivolution code.
